youtube.title: In This City, the Gate Needs 1,000 Yeses
youtube.description: An original animated tiny satire: in Yesbury the only gate out opens only if all 1,000 residents say yes at the same second. Can one girl pull it off? The story is pure fiction – the town, the gate, the numbers and the characters (Pip, Mister Hollis) are invented. No real-world claims are made.

tiktok.caption: In this city, the gate opens only if all 1,000 people say yes at the same second. Would your town ever manage it? (A tiny satire – fiction.)
